run_train_hifigan_vocoder: run the HiFi-GAN vocoder training with a config file and checkpoint path via argparse CLI
run_distributed_training: run multi-GPU distributed training of the CodeGenerator with DistributedDataParallel and a config
run_validation_loop: run the validation loop that computes mel-spectrogram L1 error and logs audio to TensorBoard
run_checkpoint_resume: resume training from an existing generator and discriminator checkpoint using scan_checkpoint and load_checkpoint
run_vqvae_commit_loss_training: run training with VQ-VAE code or f0 commitment losses logged to TensorBoard summaries
